title: Medbridge - Videos
description:
Helping healthcare professionals reach more patients with effective education and digital care solutions. Our award-winning, industry-leading platform helps practitioners optimize resources and quickly connect patients to the care they need. Our platform includes care delivery software like a Home Exercise Builder, Remote Therapeutic Monitoring, Patient-Reported Outcomes, and Digital Care Pathways; and education software like a Learning Management System, Clinical Procedure Manual, Skills & Competency Manager, and Compliance training. 

With over 2,000 accredited, evidence-based courses for PT, AT, OT, SLP, & RN professionals and organizations available online, you can start any course for free today: https://bit.ly/2N6qjUa
